errors.evidence: The description states that the pie chart contains four sectors, but there are clearly five sectors shown in the image (blue, red, orange, green, and purple).
The description incorrectly orders the sectors by size. The third largest sector is the green one at 19%, not the red one at 14.3% which is the fourth largest.
The description incorrectly identifies the smallest sector. It claims the green sector (19%) is the smallest, but the purple sector (9.5%) is actually the smallest.
The description states that the legend contains four colored markers, but it contains five, corresponding to the five sectors in the chart.
